intro: Intro of Operations › Socio access. A grant is a person's permission for a socio (an AI agent; a product noun) to use an app (such as a CRM) on their behalf.
list: Accessible name of the list of grants still in force.
empty: Shown in place of the list when no grant is in force.
ended: Toast after an admin ended a socio's access to an app.
load-failed: Shown when the grants didn't load and the server gave no reason.
end-failed: Toast when ending a grant failed and the server gave no reason.
